subject: Req46: Decision — defer hiring and reallocate headcount
messages:
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Req46: recommendation and next steps

Team —

Thanks for reviewing the packet for Req46 (Data Infrastructure Manager). After pulling together the interview scorecards and speaking with the final panel, my recommendation to the hiring committee is to decline moving forward with an offer at this time and reallocate the headcount to a short-term reliability pilot for infra SRE work. Key reasons:

- Candidate pool quality: two finalists had strong individual skills but both flagged on long-term match to the role (ownership vs. IC focus).
- Market comp: to get the profile we need would push us >20% above band midpoint for this band, squeezing the FY27 plan.
- Priority shift: infra reliability gaps surfaced in Q3 postmortem are more urgent and can be scoped as a 6–9 month pilot that offers higher ROI.

Proposed actions if committee approves:
1) Mark Req46 as "no hire — reassign FTE" and update headcount tracker.
2) Notify external candidates and the recruiting partner (TalentSource) by Friday EOD.
3) Move the approved budget to a temporary SRE pilot code 4102 for Q4–Q1 work; product and infra agree on scope.
4) Retain candidate scorecards in case we reopen as a different role; keep in ATS flagged as "consider later".

I attached the packet (req46-hiring-pack.pdf) and the combined scorecard (req46-scorecard.xlsx). Please reply with a +1 or concerns. If we have objections, we should surface them before 3pm PT so I can route to exec sign-off.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. PM, Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference

-----
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Req46: recommendation and next steps

+1 on deferring the hire and reallocating to the infra reliability pilot. A couple of operational notes:

- Compensation band: confirm that we pause any offer approvals so recruiting doesn't extend anything. If TalentSource has an active verbal for Markus, we should stop progression immediately.
- Budget reallocation: I need finance to confirm we can move the committed funds into a temporary code for the pilot; I'll loop in finance after the committee call.

If there are no objections by EOD I'll consider this approved from the infra/product perspective.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Req46: recommendation and next steps

Thanks for the clear write-up, Jasmine. I support the deferral with the following HR/recruiting next steps to avoid candidate fallout:

- I'll draft the candidate notification language and share with TalentSource. We should offer a 72-hour window to accept/decline if an offer was verbally discussed; otherwise a standard "we will not be moving forward" note.
- I'll update the ATS for Markus O'Neill and flag the req as "no hire — reassign" so reporting is accurate.
- Recruiting ask: please pause any active sourcing for this req and redirect sourcers to open SRE pilot req (I'll create a short-term job ad today).

One question: do we want to hold the band in case we decide to re-open a permanent hire in 3–6 months? If so, I'd prefer to mark it as a temporary pause but not close the band entirely. That preserves the compensation slot for future planning.

Laura Bennett
Recruiting Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Req46: Decision — defer hiring and reallocate headcount

Thanks everyone — finalizing per consensus. Actions completed/assigned: 

- Laura: please send the candidate outreach template I can sign off on. Aim to send to Markus and any other active candidates by tomorrow morning. (attachment: req46-candidate-note-draft.txt)
- Laura/Recruiting: pause all pipelining for Req46 and mark ATS as "no hire — reassign FTE". Leave the comp band in a "paused" state for internal planning.
- Vivek: I'll draft the brief for finance to request budget move to code 4102; please add your note about the pilot ROI and risks.
- Marissa/David: update the headcount tracker and org chart to show the FTE reallocation to a temporary SRE pilot (effective 2026-11-15).

I've uploaded the final packet and scorecards here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Req46Pack and added the Jira ticket JIRA-HIRE-46 to track the closure and any future reopen.

I'll close this thread after candidate outreach is complete. Thank you all for the quick turn.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. PM, Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: req46-hiring-pack.pdf (application/pdf); req46-scorecard.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
